acceptance_rule: Gate 1-4 must pass under the active post-MTM baseline with positive aggregate EV and PnL, at least two improved and no regressed windows, drawdown within guardrail, survival at least 5 percent, comparator and concentration bars passed; Gate 5 DSR controls live eligibility only.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Shared-paper-first candidate-pool alpha: after each official FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile release, publicly listed bank parents whose dominant insured-bank subsidiary exceeds 10 billion USD assets, grows core deposits year over year, and lowers its uninsured-deposit share year over year may have a strengthening deposit franchise that continues to reprice; exclude merger-like asset jumps, rank the five largest uninsured-share improvements, enter the first strictly later open, and hold 20 sessions.
locked_variables: QBP release dates fixed to official pages
FDIC financial API snapshot fixed before outcomes
current exact SEC-name map plus dominant-bank share at least 80 percent
report-date assets at least 10 billion USD
absolute YoY asset growth at most 25 percent
rank by most negative uninsured-share delta
next open strictly after QBP release
KBE XLF SPY QQQ cash comparators
no threshold rank hold notional or mapping retune
